confidence: Low: multiple real grievances; poison and glass pathway introduced without a death or handling timeline.
plausibility_notes: Live nineteenth-century poison retained at purchaser insistence is a strong theatrical contrivance, though an objection and controlled preview acknowledge the hazard.
Cancelled lighting and donor-requested camera exception are explicitly separate; neither proves a blackout or a murder.
Artie has the clearest material motive, but ordinary guests should not treat murder-themed props as proof.
